feast.note: The row is the day page this folder was read from. The whole of the life page behind it is a referral to another Greek day: «Για τον Όσιο Σεβαστιανό του Ποσεσόνε βλέπε στις 18 Δεκεμβρίου». One attestation row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here, and the fuller account on saint.gr's 18 Δεκεμβρίου was not read. Read 30 September 2026.
